text:
kira: Heads-up — PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8342
I pushed a tiny hotfix for connpool backoff that caused p99 latency spikes for router pods. Can someone give a quick review+merge? Need a canary for a 10m window.

ops-bot: deploy-check — Canary window requested. Tagging oncall.

samuel: looking. can you paste the minimal repro logs? also what's the rollback plan if things get worse?

kira: repro logs:
```
E 12:03:21 router.go:412 request=abc latency=1150ms conn_retries=3
W 12:03:22 proxy.go:88 backoff=0s -> 250ms
```
Rollback plan: revert the commit (revert PR #8342) and shift router traffic back to previous pool via the actuator endpoint. I'll open the revert PR now so it's ready.

deepti: will review in 5. can watch canary at 10:40 PST. please add 'hotfix' label and a one-line changelog.

josh: quick glance — change is small and makes sense. need CI green. i can +1 after tests pass. can you also add the exact canary timeframe in the PR comment?

kira: canary 10:40-10:50 PST across canary fleet (10% traffic). I'll kick off after CI. commands to run locally: 
```
gh pr review 8342 --approve
kubectl apply -f canary-config.yaml
```

lin: LGTM. metric watchlist: router_p99_latency and router_errors_total. suggested alert query:
```
sum(rate(router_errors_total[2m])) / sum(rate(router_requests_total[2m])) > 0.01
```
If errors > 1% sustained for 2m, revert.

pr-deploy-bot: CI passed — all checks green for PR #8342

josh: merging after canary start is fine with me.

ops-bot: Canary started at 1905002490 (10:40 PST).

kira: started canary. pinging watchers: @deepti @samuel @josh @lin

deepti: watching. :eyes:

ops-bot: Canary update — 5m in: p99 down ~30%, errors stable (no spike)

kira: looks stable, extending to full rollout in 5m if no regression. will merge then.

ops-bot: Canary finished at 1905002520 — no regressions detected. Proceeding with rollout.

kira: merged PR #8342. If anyone sees anomalies please @eng-oncall and i'll revert immediately. Thx all :tada:
